subject: Material selection for reliable manufacture
hook: Send these eight details and your quote comes back faster.
fb:
One of the most useful questions a trade customer can ask: "What do you need from me to quote?"

Here's the list: finished sizes and quantities, sheet size, board thickness, the exact decor code, grain direction on any woodgrain parts, and which edges get ABS and at what thickness. Add any drilling or assembly, and tell us whether you'll collect from Hanley or need delivery.

Send that and we'll come back with a priced cutting list. Questions about a job? Ask below.

https://superiofurniture.com/trade-services/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=kitchen-planning-month&utm_content=day-217
gbp:
What do you need to provide for a trade cutting and edging quote? Getting this right first time is the quickest way to get your job onto the saw.

Please send a cutting list with finished sizes and quantities, plus the sheet size, board thickness and exact decor code. For woodgrain decors, mark which dimension runs with the grain. Note which edges need ABS edging and in what thickness (0.4 mm, 1 mm or 2 mm). If you also need panel drilling — hinge cups, shelf-pin rows, dowel holes — or cabinet assembly, include that too, and tell us whether you'll collect from our workshop in Hanley, Stoke-on-Trent, or need delivery.

We'll come back with a priced cutting list for you to approve. Trade and domestic orders welcome. Tap Learn more to see our trade services.
